snippet.title: Hyogoslavia Chronicles – Official Trailer | A JRPG Where Japan's Hyogo Becomes a Medieval Federation
snippet.description:
Hyogo Prefecture, home to Kobe, was formed from five old provinces with very different cultures. Japanese internet users jokingly call it "Hyogoslavia."

Hyogoslavia Chronicles takes that joke seriously. Explore a medieval European-style federation of five kingdoms – Settsu, Harima, Tamba, Tajima and Awaji – on a world map shaped like Hyogo itself. Restore your party with local Hyogo food, and uncover the mystery of Akashidon, an ancient dragon sealed away three hundred years ago.

Made entirely by one developer, after hours from a full-time job.

■ Release
iOS / Android: November 20, 2026
Steam (Windows): December 10, 2026 (planned)

■ Languages
English / Japanese / Japanese (Kobe dialect)

■ Wishlist on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5466080/

■ App Store / Google Play
https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/id6821257259
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.koyurugi.hyogogame
(Store pages open on November 20)

■ Koyurugi Kobo
X: https://x.com/makaicity_chiba
Website: https://sites.google.com/view/koyurugi-koubou/

――――――――――――
【日本語】
兵庫県を中世ヨーロッパ風の連邦国家に見立てたRPG『ヒョーゴスラビア興亡記』の英語版トレーラーです。
スマホ版は11月20日発売、Steam版は12月10日発売予定です。

#HyogoslaviaChronicles #JRPG #IndieGame #RPGMaker #ヒョーゴスラビア興亡記
